ctgov.note: No US ClinicalTrials.gov registry hits; the active pilot study is being conducted in Australia.

pipeline.modality: Combination medical device (recombinant human NELL-1 protein + demineralized bone matrix putty)
pipeline.target: NELL-1 (skeletal-specific osteogenic growth factor) signaling pathway for bone regeneration
pipeline.license_origin: Exclusive worldwide license from UCLA Technology Development Group (NELL-1 for spinal fusion via local administration); DBM Putty supplied by MTF Biologics

indications.indication: Lumbar spinal fusion (transforaminal lumbar interbody fusion) in adults with single-level L2-S1 degenerative disc disease, with up to Grade 1 spondylolisthesis or retrolisthesis
indications.highest_phase: Pilot first-in-human clinical study (pre-pivotal device study; planned to be followed by US pivotal trial under PMA pathway as Class III device)
indications.trial_name: First-in-man pilot clinical study of NB1 (Australia)
indications.trial_design: Multi-center, prospective, randomized pilot study; up to 30 subjects; primary endpoints fusion success at 12 months and change from baseline in Oswestry Disability Index pain score
indications.trial_status: Enrolling (subject enrollment began 2024 in Australia per FY2025 10-K filed 2026-03-02)
key_milestones: Trial completion anticipated 12 months after enrolling the 30th subject
Pilot data intended to enable a future, larger US pivotal clinical study and PMA submission

excluded_preclinical: rhNELL-1 systemic administration for osteoporosis / disuse osteoporosis (preclinical only per 10-K)
Bone fracture / non-union and spaceflight osteopenia indications (preclinical only)
Cervical spine indication (under consideration, no clinical study)
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Pre-pivotal device-stage company; only one active first-in-human pilot study (Australia) for NB1 spinal-fusion combination device; no US IND-stage drug pipeline.
